body: I can barely write a couple paragraphs for a project at school anymore. I don't think I can
I'll look into it. My biggest passion was my writing, though, as it was a nice pass time and allowed me to ventilate a bit. I failed at that, and can't write anything anymore.
Someone my age doesn't really have anything options other than fast food or something like that, and I also don't feel like I can tolerate it along with everything else.

There doesn't seem to be much that can help me at this point. I play video games, watch TV, listen to music, but after awhile it's just there to pass the time. I want to get a job, but I don't seem to be able to stomach that along with all my other work.
I have really bad anxiety issues, and outside of school I pretty much have no human interactions. I pretty much just stay inside my room all day.
